PURPOSE: Centralized authorization facts: the fact tuple (predicate, 1-5 args of typed ID refs or literals), three-tier sourcing (centralized persisted / context per-request / local-sourced via schema), signature validation, atomic batch sync (dual-write mirror discipline), and the three decision APIs (authorize/list/actions). Clean-room adaptation target for PING capability-kernel ground statements.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: The Authorization Fact: canonical statement Fact{predicate, args[1..5] of TypedRef(type,id)|Literal}, identity=tuple equality (set semantics, idempotent insert), policy-declared signatures enforced at write, three sourcing tiers (persisted centralized / request-scoped context / locally-sourced), atomic batch write/delete. PING's capability-kernel evaluates actor/action/target but has no canonical wire/storage shape for the ground statements those evaluations depend on; add trust-kernel provenance (writer identity, source-write ref, digest) per fact, which Oso itself lacks.
